scripts.migrate:all: npm run build --workspace=services/auth-service --workspace=services/ledger-service --workspace=services/fraud-audit-service && npm run db:migrate --workspace=services/auth-service && npm run db:migrate --workspace=services/ledger-service && npm run db:migrate --workspace=services/fraud-audit-service
scripts.dev:all: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n gateway,auth,ledger,payments,notif,fraud,web -c cyan,blue,green,yellow,magenta,red,white "npm run dev --workspace=gateway" "npm run dev --workspace=services/auth-service" "npm run dev --workspace=services/ledger-service" "npm run dev --workspace=services/payments-service" "npm run dev --workspace=services/notification-service" "npm run dev --workspace=services/fraud-audit-service" "npm run dev --workspace=web"
scripts.start:all: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n gateway,auth,ledger,payments,notif,fraud -c cyan,blue,green,yellow,magenta,red "npm run start --workspace=gateway" "npm run start --workspace=services/auth-service" "npm run start --workspace=services/ledger-service" "npm run start --workspace=services/payments-service" "npm run start --workspace=services/notification-service" "npm run start --workspace=services/fraud-audit-service"
scripts.infra:up: docker compose up -d postgres redis rabbitmq
scripts.infra:reset: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d
scripts.setup: npm install && npm run infra:up && echo '\n✅  Infrastructure is up. Run npm run migrate:all once DBs are ready, then npm run dev:all'
